name: Invoke the Black Clover
body:
Minimum Spell Level: 5th.

Your other invocations are supernatural abilities. If you dedicate a 9th-level or higher spell slot to this invocation, your other invocations are extraordinary abilities instead and creatures attempting to dispel this invocation suffer a –4 circumstance penalty on checks to do so.
